1 templates hold nodes the walk never reaches:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html: Variable in `ContentBlock.variables`, line 32, Variable in `ContentBlock.variables`, line 32
description: A `@content` block that declares variables. The compiler's visitor walks the block's content and not its variables, so the walk never reaches them, and point 1 says so before it asks the block's kind: a node the walk never reaches is a kind it never checks. The day `ContentBlock` is added to `KNOWN_NODES`, this is what the walk still has to reach.
